purpose: Prevent future sessions from mixing self-report, witness inference, recovered-survivor memory, clinician interpretation, and silence.

ladder.name: no_access
ladder.description: No self-report, no recovered account, no reliable observation. The record may document absence without invention.

ladder.name: bedside_observation_only
ladder.description: External signs, movements, sounds, or context; no direct report of inner experience.

ladder.name: family_or_practitioner_interpretation
ladder.description: A witness interprets meaning from relationship, baseline, role, or repeated pattern.

ladder.name: dying_person_utterance_or_gesture
ladder.description: Words or gestures during dying that may indicate inner orientation but may also be symbolic, delirious, ambiguous, or relational.

ladder.name: direct_self_report_while_dying
ladder.description: The dying person explicitly reports dream, vision, fear, pain, comfort, breathlessness, awareness, or meaning.
ladder.public_rule: Treat as authoritative for that person only.

ladder.name: recovered_survivor_report
ladder.description: A person who survived cardiac arrest, moribund state, delirium, or other near-death condition later reports memory/experience.
ladder.public_rule: Treat as survivor testimony, not a map of death.

ladder.name: extraordinary_or_verification_claim
ladder.description: Claims about external perception, prophecy, afterlife proof, or specific unverifiable knowledge.
ladder.public_rule: Quarantine; require verification review; do not sensationalize.

hard_rule: A lower evidence channel must never be written as a higher one.
